hotel.name: Hilton Cancun, An All Inclusive Resort

verified_facts.text: The resort is tucked deep in a mangrove forest and sits on the ocean's edge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tucked deep in a mangrove forest, the property sits on the ocean’s edge nestled amongst the trees and not much else.

verified_facts.text: The property is fairly isolated, and walking into Cancun town is not an option, so guests need to plan transportation ahead.
verified_facts.excerpt: you’ll need to plan ahead for transportation as walking into town is not an option

verified_facts.text: There is a tour company on site to help with excursions.
verified_facts.excerpt: there is a tour company right onsite to help with any excursion needs

verified_facts.text: Accommodations range from ocean-view rooms to options with private swim-up patios, for two to six people.
verified_facts.excerpt: From ocean views to private swim-up patios, whether you’re looking to sleep two or six people you’ll find a wide range of accommodation offerings

verified_facts.text: Rooms are minimalist in design, with a focus on light wood and creams.
verified_facts.excerpt: With a focus on light wood and creams, all rooms are minimalist, yet thoughtfully designed.

verified_facts.text: The Deluxe Ocean Front Suite has a large living room with sofa and dining table, a king-sized bed and sitting area, two bathrooms and sweeping ocean front views.
verified_facts.excerpt: a large living room area with sofa and dining table, a king-sized bed and sitting area, and two bathrooms—all topped off by sweeping ocean front views

verified_facts.text: The resort has 12 all-inclusive dining options, including five specialty restaurants.
verified_facts.excerpt: we’ve got you covered from morning til night with 12 all-inclusive dining options

verified_facts.text: Auma is an open-fire mixed grill featuring prime cuts, where meals unfold in full view of fire and flame.
verified_facts.excerpt: An experiential open-fire mixed grill, Auma features prime cuts and house specialties where meals unfold with ritualistic theatre in full view of fire and flame.

verified_facts.text: La Luce is a trattoria built around a central wood-fired pizza oven.
verified_facts.excerpt: Choose La Luce, a convivial trattoria positioned around a central wood-fired pizza oven.

verified_facts.text: The in-room mini bar is restocked daily and, like room service, comes at no additional cost.
verified_facts.excerpt: you can plunder your in-room mini bar (which is restocked daily) or order room service, all at no additional cost

verified_facts.text: The complimentary Kid's Club is for kids aged 4 to 12.
verified_facts.excerpt: Their complimentary Kid’s Club is available for kids 4-12

verified_facts.text: A dedicated family splash playground has slides, water toys and beach games.
verified_facts.excerpt: the property’s dedicated family splash playground, which is a water wonderland featuring slides, water toys, and beach games

verified_facts.text: A dedicated TeensZone for ages 13 to 17 has TV, video and board games, and ping pong tables.
verified_facts.excerpt: a dedicated TeensZone space for ages 13-17 where teens have a relaxed area to watch TV, play video and board games, and compete at the ping pong tables

verified_facts.text: The staff are bilingual in Spanish and English.
verified_facts.excerpt: all staff I interacted with were bilingual and happy to converse in Spanish or English

verified_facts.text: Rooms come with complimentary water in recycled glass bottles that the property cleans and repurposes.
verified_facts.excerpt: All rooms come with recycled glass bottles of complimentary water that the property cleans and repurposes.

verified_facts.text: Designated accessible rooms have roll-in showers and braille signage.
verified_facts.excerpt: designated rooms that have roll-in showers and braille signage

verified_facts.text: Four bars are spread throughout the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Your favorite drink is never far away with four stylish bars throughout the resort.

verified_facts.text: Hilton Cancun does not have its own spa on site; guests use the spa at the Waldorf Astoria next door.
verified_facts.excerpt: While Hilton Cancun doesn’t have their own spa directly onsite, all guests have access to the beautiful spa at the Waldorf Astoria right next door.

verified_facts.text: Some specialty restaurants offer extra menu options for an additional fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: some of the specialty restaurants do offer extra menu options for an additional fee
